name: gh-company-formation
description: Use this skill to choose an entity and register a business in Ghana in 2026: entity types, Office of the Registrar of Companies steps, forms, fees, 1% capital duty, beneficial ownership, annual returns, the Ghana Investment Promotion Authority Act, 2026 (Act 1173) minimum foreign capital for trading enterprises, tax registration and the first tax dates. Trigger on "register a company in Ghana", "ORC Ghana", "foreign company Ghana", "GIPC minimum capital", "annual returns Ghana", "external company Ghana". Tax computations sit in the other Ghana skills.
